overview: Khelo India – Sport Tech Fund is a component of the Khelo India National Programme for Development of Sports, aimed at reviving sports culture at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports in India and establishing the nation as a sporting superpower. The programme includes verticals such as State Level Khelo India Centres, Annual Sports Competitions, Talent Search and Development, and support for sports academies, among others. It is implemented by multiple agencies including the Sports Authority of India, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, and Lakshmi Bai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE). The initiative provides financial assistance to talented athletes, infrastructure development, and opportunities for participation in national and international competitions.
objectives: Revive sports culture in India at the grass-root level
Build a strong framework for all sports played in the country
Establish India as a great sporting nation
Inspire young talent and provide top-notch infrastructure and training
Inculcate a strong spirit of participation in sports
Enable players to demonstrate their true potential
Promote sports among persons with disabilities
Enhance physical fitness of school-going children
eligibility: The Khelo India programme targets young athletes across various sports disciplines. Talented players identified in priority sports disciplines at various levels by the High-Powered Committee are provided annual financial assistance of INR 5 lakh per annum for 8 years. Support is extended to athletes participating in State Level Khelo India Centres, Annual Sports Competitions, Talent Search and Development, and other verticals under the scheme. Specific eligibility varies by vertical, including age, performance, and discipline-based criteria.
benefits: Benefits include annual financial assistance of INR 5 lakh per annum for 8 years for talented athletes, access to State Level Khelo India Centres, participation in Annual Sports Competitions (e.g., Khelo India Youth Games, University Games, Winter Games, Beach Games, Para Games), talent search and development programs, support for sports academies, promotion of sports for women and persons with disabilities, development of rural and indigenous games, physical fitness initiatives for school children, infrastructure development (play field creation/upgradation), and community coaching development through LNIPE.
financial_support: Under the Talent Search and Development vertical, talented players identified in priority sports disciplines are provided annual financial assistance of INR 5 lakh per annum for 8 years. Additional funding includes grants for State Level Khelo India Centres (e.g., ₹2 lakhs per discipline as annual recurring grant for SAI Extension centres converted to Khelo India Centres), viability gap funding for Khelo India State Centres of Excellence (KISCE), and expenditure on lodging, boarding, education, competition exposure, sports training, and equipment incurred by the Government for athletes in supported centres.
grant_amount_per_entity: INR 5 lakh per annum for 8 years
application_process: 1. Athletes are identified through talent search and development programs conducted by the High-Powered Committee. 2. Selected athletes are notified via official induction notifications (e.g., Induction Notification of Khelo India Athletes - [discipline]). 3. Athletes must submit required documents for verification and inclusion in the Khelo India athlete database. 4. Upon approval, athletes receive annual financial assistance and access to training facilities. 5. Continued support is subject to performance review and retention protocols.
required_documents: Pitch deck or business description (for partnerships)
Athlete's NSRS ID and sport discipline
Bank account details for financial assistance transfer
deadlines: Rolling basis — inductions and notifications are issued periodically throughout the year based on talent identification cycles.
implementing_agency: Sports Authority of India, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Lakshmi Bai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE)
caveats: Financial assistance is contingent on continued performance and adherence to retention protocols.
Athletes may be weeded out based on performance, injury, or failure to meet benchmarks.
Support is limited to priority sports disciplines as determined by the High-Powered Committee.
The programme does not guarantee permanent employment or long-term sponsorship beyond the 8-year assistance period.
Funding for centres and infrastructure is subject to budgetary allocations and utilization certificates.
